description: CCDC_2244618 crystallizes in the trigonal crystal system with space group R -3. Reported CIF formula moiety: C73 H156 Cu24 Gd6 N36 O87, 16(Cl1 O4). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Cu1 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu4 (Cu) has 7 O neighbors; Cu2 (Cu) has 4 O neighbors; Cu3 (Cu) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd6Cu24(IM)12(L-Al)12(μ3-OH)30(μ2-OH)6(CO3)(H2O)24]·(ClO4)16·(H2O)6. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 30 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 24 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
